title: MetaMask Extension Perps smoke
description: Non-mutating Perps domain smoke for MetaMask Extension: verifies CDP, unlocks if needed, opens the Perps page, and reads live Perps positions and orders.

status.intent: Resolve the Extension checkout and adapter status before Perps proof

cdp.intent: Confirm the Extension CDP runtime is reachable

ensure-unlocked.intent: Ensure the wallet is unlocked before opening Perps

read-positions.intent: Read live Perps positions without mutating account state

read-orders.intent: Read live Perps open orders without mutating account state
